# Exact and lax interventional causal abstraction, composition, and Causal Goodhart

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`interventional-causal-abstraction-and-goodhart` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](interventional-causal-abstraction-and-goodhart.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> CausalSystem, ExactCausalAbs, and LaxCausalAbs unify interventions across Mechanism, Experiment, ExchangeLaw, and OpenComposition, transfer Viability kernels across scales and policies, separate passive lumping from Causal Goodhart, and lift GrammarLaws and Sensitive closure.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom (Init-only L1 core). Open-loop LaxCausalAbs transfer requires α Δ + ε ≤ Δ (or α = id over finite horizon < σ N - σ 0) and buffered safety margin; closed-loop feedback transfer additionally requires Δ-robust closedness or Δ-ball constancy of κ.
- Horizontal OpenComposition composition requires boundary locality and synchronous macro alarm witnesses; ExchangeLaw abstraction requires Nonanticipating and finite condition coverage cs.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Empirical causal discovery of intervention alignment ω or micro transition kernels from purely passive finite traces (explicitly obstructed by causal_underdetermined_of_untaken and mechanism_intervention_underdetermined).
- Distributional or KL/wasserstein interventional distance metrics beyond discrete Nat SlackDist.
- Automatic policy optimization over counterfactual interventions or value/ethical entailment.
- **Counterexample:** CausalGoodhartWitness: passive dynamics satisfy ProjectedLaws.Commuting identically on all 16 states and eternal Viability.Kernel, macro .boost increases the proxy (2 -> 3) eternally safely, yet micro .boostProxy exhausts the coupled hidden reserve, violating guardS at step 2 and collapsing even guardQ ∘ π to (.zero, .zero) at step 3. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalAbstraction.lean)
- **Counterexample:** HorizontalLeakageWitness: exact under passive obs, exact marginal A under every intervention, and exact B under passive A, yet cross-boundary interventional reset on A refutes every ω : Bool × Bool -> Bool × Bool (no_exact_causal_abs, no_zero_slack_lax_abs). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalAbstraction.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.
